claim: Widest entitled SIP daily coverage measured for 17,997 US-listed symbols over 2,693 sessions (2016-01-04 to 2026-09-18) with page-hash and pagination proofs; a frozen broad-universe mover protocol evaluated chronologically once, establishing no predictive signal; and a dated full-universe scan in which META and AMD ranked 14th and 19th of 1,795 eligible names.
limitations: Survivorship exposure before 2020: only 25/47/167 symbols end in 2016/2017/2018 because the provider asset list under-enumerates delisted names and corporate-action records are thin before 2020.
Daily-bar event study with modelled costs; no opening-auction price, halts, quotes or portfolio simulation; not attainable P&L and not a paper or broker result.
Identity is provider-symbol based: 155 duplicated ticker series were removed, 80 partial overlaps (0.12% of rows) and 235 undated ticker collisions remain.
No paper order was placed: no signal met promotion, the session was closed, and multi-session horizons do not fit the frozen 300-second adaptive trial.
Scan flags are research flags, not predictions; provider mover screens are bounded top-N lists; tests are local synthetic-fixture checks.
